# IHA Restaurant

> Where Nature Meets Taste — An immersive dining experience inspired by nature, crafted with passion in Vallam, Tamil Nadu.

## Overview
IHA Restaurant is a premier botanical dining destination located in Vallam (near Tenkasi), Tamil Nadu. The restaurant offers a unique dining experience set amidst organic architectural elements, open garden tables, and lush green plants. It features live grill stations, authentic tandoor cooking, handcrafted mocktails, and rich Indian and oriental cuisine.

## Essential Details
- **Official Website**: https://ihagroups.in
- **Full Address**: Vachi nagar, Vallam, Tamil Nadu 627809, India
- **Cuisine**: South Indian, North Indian, Arabian & Grilled Specialties, Tandoori Delicacies, Artisan Beverages & Desserts
- **Atmosphere**: Natural botanical architecture, open-air garden seating, family-friendly spaces, private celebration areas
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Sunday, 12:00 PM – 11:00 PM (Daily)

## Master Chefs & Culinary Leadership
- **Chef Rajsen Singh (Executive Master Chef & Culinary Director)**: 20+ years of mastery in live charcoal wood-fire grilling and tandoor craft (https://ihagroups.in/#master-chefs).
- **Chef Ajay Kumar (Senior Sous Chef & Sauce Artisan)**: 15+ years specialist in micro-garnishes, oriental barbecue fusion, and authentic spiced marinades.

## Chef's Signature Dishes
- **Dragon Chicken**: Crisp wok-tossed chicken coated in rich oriental sweet-savory glaze with garden scallions.
- **Flame-Grilled Chicken**: Slow-cooked over open wood coals, basted in house-special spice butter.
- **Paneer Butter Masala**: Silky cottage cheese simmered in velvety slow-simmered spiced cashew and tomato gravy.
- **Special Arabian Shawarma**: Marinated, tender shaved meat with garlic aioli and fresh pickled vegetables.
- **Royal Falooda**: Traditional layered chilled delight with sabja seeds, rose syrup, fine vermicelli, and ice cream scoops.
- **Live Grill & Barbeque**: Tableside-served hot tandoori platters and skewers prepared fresh.

## Dining Spaces & Experiences
- **Botanical Main Hall**: Indoor dining with warm lighting, natural leaf aesthetics, and acoustic balance (https://ihagroups.in/#experience).
- **Open Garden Pavilions**: Starlit open-air tables surrounded by fresh vegetation.
- **Private Celebration Spaces**: Curated dining setup for birthday parties, anniversaries, family gatherings, and corporate dinners (https://ihagroups.in/#celebrate).
- **Interactive Live Kitchen**: Open view of the tandoor and grill ovens.

## Key Policies & Services
- **Dietary Accommodations**: Extensive separate menu sections for pure vegetarian and halal-certified non-vegetarian cuisine.
- **Walk-ins**: Walk-in guests are always welcomed. Advanced table reservations are recommended for weekend dinners and large groups (https://ihagroups.in/#reservation).
- **Takeaway & Delivery**: Available on request via direct restaurant phone and WhatsApp.
